helpText: The unique Settings Asset ID used by ItemFlavors. If you want to reference an ItemFlavor via playlist, just copy and paste the whole SAID00000000123 string.
Used to clip a logo's emblem and background to ensure assets don't leak out from under the frame.
Overrides the vertical 'center line' of the frame. This affects where the emblem and background are placed relative to the frame. -1.0 is the bottom of the image, 0.0 is the center, 1.0 is the top.
If this is selected, it will tell the game to pull a seclection from the 'Favorites' list
If this is selected, this element will be available in the logo editor.
